pages.text:
Boils water into steam with up to 80 HU/t. Feed it more heat than that and it climbs toward its heat source's temperature, making better steam; underfeed it and it sits near 100°C making plain Steam.
If it cools into a lower grade, the steam it holds drops to that grade.
Water goes in on its input face (or from buckets), steam comes out of its output face.
